title: Absolutely not!
body:
Two things to note:
1.  This is yet another app that insists on signing users up for a trial subscription that auto renews after a week. This is not an ethical practice. Developers need to stop this dodgy way of signing users up to their subscriptions.
2. The app’s methodology is clearly inspired by the pseudoscientific practices associated with NLP mixed with self-help nonsense like accessing a “secret source of power”.

My advice? Give these apps a wide berth.
author: bird yellow
